declared.status: release candidate under review: not released, not tagged, not deployed, not published

declared.forecast: the M2 projection is archived and has never been scored against observed demand
declared.m2_advantage: not established: the lead over the best simple baseline B* is not significant after Holm, and a correctly sized selection test would most likely have kept B* (docs/BACKTESTING.md section 12)
declared.m2_selection_evidence: weak: the development selection test over-rejects at h=30 (M8 erratum, docs/BACKTESTING.md)
declared.m3_intervals: FAILED_CALIBRATION: no prediction interval or exceedance probability is validated for operational use (docs/UNCERTAINTY.md)
declared.m4_parameters: every staffing, cost, productivity and budget parameter is HYPOTHETICAL (docs/OPTIMIZATION.md)
declared.nature: independent research software on the frozen legacy-v0 snapshot: not an official or operational NYC tool, and not affiliated with or endorsed by the City of New York, NYC 311 or NYC Open Data

m2_projection.label: FUTURE PROJECTION: forecasts beyond the last observed day. No outcome has been observed; these numbers are not validated by any backtest.

snapshot.source: NYC Open Data (City of New York): 311 Service Requests from 2020 to Present (dataset erm2-nwe9)
snapshot.terms_of_use: Published by NYC Open Data. The applicable terms of use were not verified in this repository; confirm them before redistribution.

source.fingerprint_rule: sha256 over the sorted lines 'path NUL mode SP sha256 LF', one per tracked file except this manifest, where mode and sha256 are those of the content git committed (git ls-files -s, git cat-file), not of the working tree

site.content_security_policy: default-src 'none'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; img-src 'self'; font-src 'self'; connect-src 'self'; manifest-src 'self'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'; object-src 'none'; require-trusted-types-for 'script'; trusted-types 'none'

declared.server: Ubuntu 24.04 LTS, x86-64-v2 or aarch64, 1 vCPU/1 GB + 1 GB swap minimum, 2 vCPU/2 GB recommended, nginx and Python 3.12 from Ubuntu (docs/DEPLOYMENT.md section 3)
